products.name: Cordy Desktop
products.notes: 0.5.4 is available for Windows x64 only. For macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (x64/arm64), use [Cordy Desktop 0.5.3](https://github.com/DS-Studio/cordy-releases/releases/tag/desktop-v0.5.3). There is no Windows-on-ARM build. The Windows installer is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen warns you on first run — see the install guide.
products.notesZh: 0.5.4 仅提供 Windows x64 版本。macOS（Apple Silicon）与 Linux（x64/arm64）请使用 [Cordy 桌面端 0.5.3](https://github.com/DS-Studio/cordy-releases/releases/tag/desktop-v0.5.3)。没有 Windows on ARM 版本。Windows 安装包未做代码签名，首次运行时 Windows SmartScreen 会弹出警告——见安装文档。

products.name: Cordy for Chrome

channel.note: Install from the Chrome Web Store — it is the only supported way to install this extension, and it keeps itself updated.
channel.noteZh: 请从 Chrome 应用商店安装——这是本扩展唯一受支持的安装方式，且会自动保持更新。

products.notes: The .zip is published so the package can be verified, not as an alternate way to install. Install from the Chrome Web Store.
products.notesZh: 此处的 .zip 用于核对安装包，不是另一条安装途径。请从 Chrome 应用商店安装。
